note: Semi-primitive Forest Service campground in the oak savanna of the Sheyenne National Grassland, for campers with and without horses. Gravel pads; access to the North Country Scenic Trail and the Oak Leaf Trail; cattle grazing and prescribed fire on the surrounding grassland. --Claude
summary: USFS page + rec.gov read: 14 sites (8 general, 6 equestrian per rec.gov; FS says 7/7), $10, FCFS only, 14-day limit, no hookups, vault toilets, hand pump (spring-fall), no dump, open year-round with limited services. Groups written; max_rig 50 -> 40 for non-horse sites. Pin ok. Horse-camp question flagged.
flags: HORSE CAMP (reviewer): the equestrian sites (4, 7-11) are not physically separate - they are interleaved with the non-equestrian sites in the same three loops (East: 2, 3 general + 4, 7, 8 horse; Central: 1, 6, 12-14 general + 9 horse; West: 5 general + 10, 11 horse). But it is a general campground that offers horse sites, not a horse camp with a few extra sites: the non-equestrian sites are the majority (8 of 14 on rec.gov; FS says 7 and 7), one is typed RV, and rec.gov describes it as 'a semi-primitive recreation opportunity for most camping types and equestrian use'. Read as a keep under the curation doc's 'a general campground that merely offers horse sites is OK'; the reviewer decides.
FIT: 6 non-equestrian sites post 30-40 ft (1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 13); FS says 'Parking pads up to 60-feet long'. County Road 23 gravel; no FS road warning read.
PIN: stored 46.52456,-97.20178 is on the campground loops (FS page 46.524659,-97.20144, 27 m): ok.
PHONE: keep 701-404-8950 (Sheyenne Ranger District office on the FS page; the page's contact line also gives 701-683-4342).
WEBSITE: the stored rec.gov link is fine; the FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/dpg/recreation/jorgens-hollow-campground carries the season and fee - suggest adding it as the first website line.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands (no water at the campground; the Sheyenne River access is 1.5 mi away).
